title: Daily Offerings

questions.question: What is the regular daily burnt offering?
options: Two male lambs a year old without blemish, one in the morning, one at twilight
questions.correctAnswer: Two male lambs a year old without blemish, one in the morning, one at twilight
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:3-4 (ESV): "Two male lambs... day by day... One lamb in the morning... the other... at twilight."

questions.question: On the Sabbath day, what is added to the daily offering?
options: Two male lambs, with grain and drink offering
questions.correctAnswer: Two male lambs, with grain and drink offering
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:9 (ESV): "On the Sabbath day, two male lambs... and a drink offering."

questions.question: At the beginning of each month (new moon), what is the offering?
options: Two bulls, one ram, seven lambs, and a goat for sin offering
questions.correctAnswer: Two bulls, one ram, seven lambs, and a goat for sin offering
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:11, 15 (ESV): "At the beginnings of your months... two bulls... one ram, seven male lambs... also one male goat..."

questions.question: During the Passover (Unleavened Bread), the offering is made for how many days?
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:17, 24 (ESV): "Seven days... unleavened bread... You shall offer daily, for seven days..."

questions.question: When is the feast of weeks (firstfruits)?
options: When you offer a grain offering of new grain
questions.correctAnswer: When you offer a grain offering of new grain
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:26 (ESV): "On the day of the firstfruits, when you offer a grain offering of new grain..."

questions.question: What is the drink offering for a lamb?
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:7 (ESV): "Its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin for each lamb."

questions.question: What is the drink offering for a bull?
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:14 (ESV): "Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull..."

questions.question: Are these offerings in addition to the regular daily burnt offering?
What work is allowed on the first day of Unleavened Bread?
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:18 (ESV): "You shall not do any ordinary work."

questions.question: What animal is typically offered for a sin offering in these feasts?
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:15, 22, 30 (ESV): "And one male goat for a sin offering..."

questions.question: The daily offering is synonymous with what phrase?
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:3 (ESV): "This is the food offering... a continual burnt offering."

questions.question: When is Passover kept?
options: Fourteenth day of the first month
questions.correctAnswer: Fourteenth day of the first month
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:16 (ESV): "On the fourteenth day of the first month is the Lord's Passover."

questions.question: Why is Strong Drink mentioned in verse 7?
options: To be poured out as a drink offering to the Lord in the Holy Place
questions.correctAnswer: To be poured out as a drink offering to the Lord in the Holy Place
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:7 (ESV): "In the Holy Place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the Lord."

questions.question: How much flour for a ram?
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:12 (ESV): "And two tenths of an ephah of fine flour... for the ram."

questions.question: Is the Sabbath offering offered morning and evening?
options: It is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: It is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering
questions.explanation: Numbers 28:10 (ESV): "This is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering..."

key_verse_text: Command the people of Israel and say to them, 'My offering, my food for my food offerings, my pleasing aroma, you shall be careful to offer to me at its appointed time.'
